items.title: Harrison Barnes Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: I only left two tramboyant plays when I was Sonny Henry and the fellow by the name of Arthur.

ctx.x: How late did you stay in music? When did you retire from music?

Oh, the sickness. I had what they call a tumor. Broke out on my hip. And it got graduated, graduated to about a year or so. It got put in as big as a baseball. And then my blood was bad. Now that, I had got a test about six months, less than six months. I went, it was negative. And I got another test. It was positive. So, the nurse said, well I got a test the first time. I said, it can't be. I said, we're taking your blood test and this. And so, they took it again and they told me, yeah, it was bad. Well I had to…
Which church was that that had music and had a band?
